question: In a standard FIBA (International) game, how many quarters are played, and how long is each quarter?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Four 10-minute quarters**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **FIBA Basketball Rules:** In a standard **FIBA (International Basketball Federation)** game, the game is divided into **four quarters**, each lasting **10 minutes**. This is a globally accepted format for international basketball matches.
 
• **Game Duration:** The total duration of the game is **40 minutes**, excluding stoppages, overtime (if applicable), and breaks between quarters.
 
• **Break Intervals:** There is a **2-minute break** between the first and second quarters as well as the third and fourth quarters. A longer **15-minute halftime break** is observed between the second and third quarters.
 
• **Overtime Rules:** If the game ends in a tie after the fourth quarter, **overtime periods** of **5 minutes** each are played until a winner is decided.
